input.command:
DISPLAY=:0 python3 << 'EOF'
import pyautogui
import time

# Click on the address bar
pyautogui.click(700, 90)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Select all and clear
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('delete')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Type the URL for Chrome's password manager
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://password-manager/passwords', interval=0.01)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1.5)
print("done")
EOF
